description.fun: Relicanth has stayed unchanged for 100 million years because, as one Pokédex puts it, it's already a perfect life form. It was discovered on a deep-sea expedition and named after the explorer who found it, much as the real coelacanth's genus is named after the person who identified the first living one. Its teeth withered away long ago, so it sucks up tiny organisms with its toothless mouth.
description.guide: A Water- and Rock-type Pokémon based on the coelacanth, a 'living fossil' fish, built to withstand the pressure of the ocean depths. It does not evolve.
description.tagline: A living fossil fish unchanged for 100 million years
